# Castlebury Dental

> > Castlebury Dental provides comprehensive family dentistry services in Eagle and Meridian, Idaho, featuring Invisalign orthodontics, cosmetic treatments, and preventive care from experienced dentists.

Castlebury Dental is a full-service dental practice serving the Eagle and Meridian communities in Idaho's Treasure Valley region. The practice offers a wide range of services from routine cleanings and preventive care to advanced cosmetic and orthodontic treatments like Invisalign, with a team of four experienced dentists and flexible payment options.

- Invisalign clear aligners
